Rene Clert “Bobet” Baterbonia was a promising young student-athlete from Talacogon, Agusan del Sur. He was a Palarong Pambansa MVP and led the Davao Region to its first-ever basketball title before being recruited to play for the Ateneo Blue Eagles. He tragically passed away in a drowning incident during a team-building activity in Aurora on June 8, 2026.
A tribute song titled “Bituin ng Mindanao” was created to honor his legacy as an inspiration to the youth of Mindanao. The song has gradually become an object of ridicule due to actions taken by his mother.
